title: A boolean filter argument that references a measure is an error
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], Customer[Country] = "US" && [Sales Amount] > 100 ) )

expected.error: A measure reference (an implicit CALCULATE) has been used in a True/False expression that is used as a table filter expression. This is not allowed.

source.supports: the rules for Boolean filter expressions

source.quote: It cannot reference a measure, and it cannot use CALCULATE.
source.supports: the limits of a True/False filter argument
